args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

src/money.py documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN but implemented
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the
nightly build. Replace ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Changes
- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py::round_money` so that the implementation matches FIN-212 and the existing docstring.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` (commit 08d3cd5986) passed on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding`.
